t**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

d**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

f**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

b**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

t**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

l**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

a**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

r**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

 **Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,

c**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

`**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

.**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

`**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

e**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

s**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

w**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

h**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative

v**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

l**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

a**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

t**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative

-**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

d**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,

a**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

/**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

i**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

r**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

 **Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

 **Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

i**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

/**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

t**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

.**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,

;**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,

n**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

t**Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

 **Layout (sheet 3).** The site's shared controls drive the globe like every sheet: **Animate**
plays month by month on the globe (the sheet's `play` hook), Speed sets the rate, and the monthly
chart below follows the same clock. Above the globe: the date (year set large, then the day in
words and UTC time), the running count of objects down, and **Skip quiet intervals** (description
on hover). Beside the globe, **Now** lists the events in progress and the next one with a short
card for the selected one, and **Appearance** holds the saved display settings, scrolling in place
so changes are visible on the globe. Directly under the globe, the **event strip** shows every
reentry and launch of the year, one lane per kind, on a month axis: drag it to move the clock,
click a tick to jump to that object, ◀ year ▶ to change year. **Fine time** below it moves the
clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).

clock by the minute within the day, or ±10 min / ±1 h. Hour-scale speeds play month by month and
continue automatically; at year-scale speeds the globe waits and only the charts move. Collapsed
sections underneath hold the events-reached log, **About this view** (a known-versus-illustrative
table and the limits), and **Other examples** (the April 2–9, 2018 sample with Dragon CRS-14,
Dragon alone, Tiangong-1, and two Iridium 33 debris fallbacks).
